oneLine: Anthropic's planned IPO draws attention with major tech investments.

sources.title: Anthropic IPO: Why Google’s 13% stake and Big Tech’s $900-billion AI bet hinge on Claude maker’s success | Decoded
Anthropic promises to pursue humanitys benefit. Its IPO filing gives it wiggle room
Who are Anthropic’s seven founders who became multibillionaires after Claude AI maker’s historic IPO?

synopsis: Anthropic is planning an initial public offering on the Nasdaq, with expected share prices between $70 and $78. Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company are collectively investing $26 billion at the IPO price. Google is expected to own about 13% of the company after the public offering. The IPO could generate more than $90 billion in proceeds.
